proposal.reason: Main change removes CollNet execution and plugin loading/proxy paths from collective networking (`network`). It also deletes the dedicated CollNet transport wiring and connection management (`transport`), removes CollNet device-kernel/function-table implementations while keeping a reserved null algorithm slot (`kernels`), removes CollNet logical graph construction/connection logic (`graph-search`), drops CollNet-related NIC/topology capability handling (`device-topology`), and updates algorithm/protocol cost-model enablement and fallback behavior to keep CollNet ID 2 reserved but unselectable (`tuning`).
